safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting advice to seek earlier review if symptoms worsen weakens safety-netting for acute gastroenteritis, potentially delaying evaluation for dehydration, worsening infection, or other abdominal pathology. While the note includes a follow-up timeframe if not improving, lack of “come back sooner if worse” guidance can lead to avoidable deterioration before reassessment.
